big_case.notes: A private Maryland residential-fraud suit whose live dispute is a statutory attorney's-fee order; the federal hook is a Caperton-style due process claim that a recalled retired judge was practicing law when he signed a one-page fee order, with the dispositive employment timing unresolved below. Private parties, solo counsel, no circuit or state-court conflict alleged, response waived, no amicus, denied on the first conference without any noted dissent. Reaction nil. A grant would have mattered chiefly to Maryland's senior-judge recall practice. Formed from the record and outcome; the three predictors' big_case_score values were visible in the staged prediction.json files I had to read for the probabilities, so this read is independent in substance but not strictly blind to them.
